Effects on the uterine musculature
Prostaglandins of the E and F series, as well as TXA2, contract the uterine musculature. In fact, prostaglandins E and F are inducers of
labor and can be used in therapeutic abortion (Szczuko et al., 2020).

Effects on the gastrointestinal tract
PGI2 and PGE2 inhibit acid secretion in the stomach. Prostaglandins of the E series also increase mucus secretion in the stomach and
small intestine and stimulate intestinal motility.
Effects on the kidney
PGE2 and PGI2 decrease vascular resistance and increase renal blood ﬂow. In addition, PGE2 inhibits the reabsorption of sodium
chloride in the cortical collecting tubes, hinders the action of antidiuretic hormone and stimulates the release of renin. TXA2, which
is vasoconstrictor, is also produced in the kidney.
Effects on the bronchial tree
Prostaglandins of the E series relax the musculature of the bronchi and trachea, while those of the F series produce bronchospasm.
The bronchoconstrictor action is especially important in the case of the leukotrienes LTC4 and LTD4 (Yonker et al., 2021).
